description: Source code for a Kubernetes code generator component that handles validation generation, including parsing comments for tags, managing package and type information, and orchestrating validation target creation.

methods.name: extractAndParseTag
methods.description: Extracts all values for a specific tag from comments, parsing them into codetags.Tags.

methods.name: extractMainTag
methods.description: Extracts the main validation generation tags from comments.

methods.name: extractInputTag
methods.description: Extracts input package tags from comments.

methods.name: checkMainTag
methods.description: Checks if main tag matches required values, used for opt-in/out.

methods.name: schemeRegistryTag
methods.description: Retrieves the scheme registry package name from package comments.

methods.name: isSubresourceTag
methods.description: Determines if a type is marked as a subresource via comments.

methods.name: supportedSubresourceTags
methods.description: Retrieves supported subresources for a type based on comments.

methods.name: testFixtureTag
methods.description: Retrieves test fixture tags from package comments.

methods.name: NameSystems
methods.description: Returns the name systems used for naming conventions in code generation.

methods.name: validationFnNamer
methods.description: Creates a naming strategy for validation functions with 'Validate_' prefix.

methods.name: GetTargets
methods.description: Main function to generate validation targets based on context and arguments.

methods.name: isTypeWith
methods.description: Checks if a type has fields matching specified names, used for validation filtering.
